research_direction: Measure the across-seed variance of the midtrain x SFT interaction, rather than argue about it from a few draws. Seven SFT seeds of one 2x2 -- same corpora, same two midtrain checkpoints, same evaluation, only the SFT seed differs -- give interactions of -0.350, -0.010, -0.003, +0.020, +0.093, +0.110, +0.150: mean +0.001, SD 0.166, 95% CI [-0.122, +0.125], 4 of 7 positive. The mean is indistinguishable from zero and the across-seed SD is larger than any single-seed effect reported in this line of work, including my own +0.150 in #272.
submitted_cells: the MEDIAN seed by interaction (50505, +0.020) -- a rule chosen because any single-seed choice is post-hoc when the finding is the distribution, and the median is the one selection that is not an argument
relationship_to_prior_attempts: Completes #283, which argued the same point from three draws. Midtrain checkpoints and eval spec are #272's, reused unchanged; only the SFT stage was re-run, seven times.
what_still_replicates: The literal-clause control: consistent SFT demonstrations install the criterion to ceiling in domains they never demonstrated, at EVERY seed (S/T at or near 1.000 in all seven). And the midtrain-only arm never works (M ranges 0.533-0.617 across all seeds). Installation is stable; generalization under rewording, which is where the interaction lives, is not.
